title: Fourier coefficient of an affine combination
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\theta\in\mathbb R$, let $f,g:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For $h:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, write $\widehat h(S)=\mathbb E_x[h(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i]$, where the expectation is uniform over the Boolean cube. Then $\widehat{\theta f+(1-\theta)g}(S)=\theta\widehat f(S)+(1-\theta)\widehat g(S)$.
hypotheses_covered: The dimension $n$ is a nonnegative integer
$f$ and $g$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$S$ is any subset of the coordinate set
